picks.why: Vertiv has 24% revenue growth, a 20% operating margin and a 22.7x forward P/E, and the shortlist shows it 45% below its 52-week high even after today's report of 61% sales growth and organic orders over 100%. It is the one overweight segment with no name on the watchlist and ties directly to the power-is-the-binding-constraint thesis.
picks.risk: The 15% jump and FCF yield of only 3% leave little cushion if the Fed or hyperscaler capex disappoints.

picks.risk: The market may be right that grid orders are peaking, and the stock is still 11% below its 200-day average.
